title: ruling needed(components/core): which rung wins the record title — PageHeaderRenderer ranks `titleFormat` above the ADR-0079 declared pointer, `getRecordDisplayName` ranks it below (option C of objectui#8351)
body:
Ruled: 5814246926 · letter ratified (C1: declared pointer outranks titleFormat) · 2026-09-24T12:37Z

Split out of objectui#8351 by the ruling recorded there (director seat, decision batch #82, 2026-09-08, maintainer 「同意」), which ruled option **B** into `plugin-detail` and said of this half, verbatim:

> **C** — closing the ordering divergence at its source in `@object-ui/components` so `PageHeaderRenderer` stops ranking `titleFormat` above the ADR-0079 name pointer — is a real contract question that changes what the H1 shows on existing records and retires a green pin (`page-header-title.test.tsx`: `titleFormat still outranks nameField`). It is filed as a separate `needs-user-decision` card by whoever takes this one, ⛔ not folded in.

⛔ Not claimed, ⛔ not graded, ⛔ no implementation attached. B landed separately and deliberately does **not** depend on which rung wins the header.

## The divergence

Two implementations of one ADR-0079 concept order two rungs oppositely:

- **`@object-ui/core`'s `getRecordDisplayName`** (`packages/core/src/utils/record-title.ts`) documents and implements `objectDef.titleFormat` at **step 3** — **below** the declared pointer (`nameField`, step 1; `displayNameField`, step 2). Its own docblock calls the template "LEGACY, render-only, kept for back-compat only; an explicitly-declared field (1/2) now wins over it."
- **`PageHeaderRenderer`** (`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`, the `resolvedTitle` ladder) ranks the interpolated `titleFormat` **above** the unified resolver: the template rung is tried first, and the ADR-0079 resolver is only consulted when the template yields nothing usable.

So on an object declaring **both**, the H1 a user reads and the name every other surface resolves (gallery, calendar, lookup, search, related lists) are **different fields**.

## Why this needs a ruling rather than a repair

⭐ **The divergence is asserted, not overlooked.** `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-title.test.tsx` carries a currently-green case named **`titleFormat still outranks nameField`**. Whichever way this goes, somebody has to deliberately overturn a standing assertion — that is what makes it a ruling and not a defect.

⚠️ **It moves user-visible output on existing records.** Any object that declares a `nameField` *and* a `titleFormat` has its detail-page H1 change the day this lands. Nothing in the tree measures how many such objects exist in real applications; that population is unmeasured and, per the discipline on unmeasured reach, must not be treated as zero.

## Options

- **C1 — make the header match `getRecordDisplayName`.** The declared pointer outranks the template everywhere; `titleFormat` becomes the fallback its own docblock already says it is. One implementation of ADR-0079. Cost: the H1 changes on existing records, and `titleFormat still outranks nameField` is retired and rewritten to assert the opposite.
- **C2 — make `getRecordDisplayName` match the header.** ADR-0079 is amended so the rendered template outranks the declared pointer everywhere. Also one implementation, and no detail-page H1 moves — but it moves the resolved name on *every other* surface instead (gallery, calendar, lookup, search, related lists), and it contradicts ADR-0079's stated direction, which deliberately de-prioritised the legacy template.
- **C3 — leave both and declare the divergence.** Zero user-visible movement. Cost: two orderings stay, the green pin keeps asserting the one that contradicts the ADR, and the next reader has to rediscover this. Under this option the divergence should at least be named in both files so it stops reading as an oversight.

## Four facets

- **① Long-term project soundness.** C1 is the contract-first answer: it makes the renderer honour the ADR instead of amending the ADR to match one renderer. C2 is coherent but inverts a decision already taken. C3 keeps the special case alive. ⇒ C1 best, C3 worst.
- **② Real business pull.** Nothing is blocked. objectui#8351's option B already removed the symptom that was actually costing users a vanished grid row. This is correctness of the H1 itself, not an outage. ⇒ weak pull, which is why it is a ruling and not a P1.
- **③ Preventing AI error.** Two implementations of one documented rule, with the divergent one pinned green, is exactly the shape that produces confident wrong reasoning: an agent reading either half alone derives a correct-looking and wrong conclusion. ⇒ C1 or C2 (either collapses the two into one); C3 keeps the trap and can only mitigate it with prose.
- **④ Startup-stage non-proliferation.** C3 costs nothing today. C1 costs one pin rewrite plus a changeset that declares moved H1 output. C2 costs the same mechanically but spreads the behaviour change across more surfaces.

**Recommendation: C1**, on ① and ③. ⚠️ **Confidence gap, stated rather than hidden:** how many real objects declare both `nameField` and `titleFormat` has not been measured, and that number is the whole difference between "a quiet correction" and "a visible rename across a customer's records". If the maintainer wants that measured before ruling, that is a reasonable answer too and the census belongs on this card.

## Maintainer speed-read (中文)

详情页大标题用的排序,和平台其它地方(列表、日历、查找、关联列表)解析「这条记录叫什么」用的排序,**是反的**。对象同时声明了 `nameField` 和 `titleFormat` 时,两边显示的是不同字段。根因是同一条规则有两份实现,顺序相反,**而且相反的那一份还被一个当前绿着的测试钉着**。

统一它们会**改变现有记录上大标题的显示内容**,并且要退掉那个测试。所以这不是修 bug,是裁定。

**你要做的:回一个选项 —— C1(让大标题跟随 ADR-0079 的声明字段,推荐)/ C2(反过来改 ADR,让模板胜出)/ C3(两边都不动,只把分歧写进注释)。** 若想先量一量「同时声明两者的对象到底有多少」再定,也直接说。

## Scope note

⛔ `page:header`'s own `schema.title` is a **third**, separate case, and is out of scope here as it was on objectui#8351: it is a key on the header schema, `plugin-detail` cannot see it, and a dedupe keyed on "which single field is the H1" is structurally unable to answer it. Same shape, its own card if it is wanted.

## Related

objectui#8351 (where this was ruled out of scope and B landed) · objectui#8175 · objectui#7287 · objectui#7586 · objectui#8350 · ADR-0079

## Dedup

`/search/issues` is 403 in this container, so: REST list endpoints plus a local grep over the merged corpus — **all 429 open issues** (paged to a short page), **all 25 `needs-user-decision` issues and PRs, state=all**, objectui#8351's own cross-reference timeline, and 1902 closed issues. Grepped for `titleFormat`, `nameField`, `PageHeaderRenderer`, `ADR-0079`, `getRecordDisplayName`, `page-header-title` across title and body. 38 cards matched; all read. Nearest are objectui#7586 (the `primaryField` read on the same header ladder — a different key, and retired) and objectui#8175 / objectui#8350 (the dedupe ladder's field and emptiness halves, both landed). **None asks the precedence question between these two rungs.** Two control words were run against the same corpus in the same pass and both fired on objectui#8351, the known-certain hit: `titleFormat still outranks nameField` returned 1, `PageHeaderRenderer ranks` returned 1 — so the zero for "an existing C card" is a reading, not an artefact of a dead channel.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat while implementing objectui#8351's option B, in discharge of the obligation the ruling placed on whoever took that card. Generated by Claude Code, session `session_011QreXiyMEqKLN4U5daMPVa`.
